camera-space oriented geometric direction, host buffer xyz; not RGB/rendered normal

limitations: The observed images are training views of the frozen original model; view2 is held out from the local solver only. No GT reconstruction metric or Gaussian parameter backpropagation. Host warp_patch_ncc uses squared signed correlation and a 5e-6 variance gate, whereas this probe uses signed 1-ZNCC on grayscale with variance >1e-8; native, photo and joint are compared under this same probe metric. No reliable isolated converged joint branch was found, so implicit-solution derivatives were not evaluated. The 32-ray denominator is retained; unavailable photometric costs are null and invalidate the pass gate.
